cards.title: Revenge
cards.description: The last player who was shocked chooses the next target manually. Then the fate spinner starts.

cards.title: Dealer's Choice
cards.description: The host chooses the next target manually. Then the fate spinner starts.

cards.title: Mob Justice
cards.description: The group decides who goes next. Use the buttons to register the group's choice.

cards.title: Lucky Escape
cards.description: The previous selected target is immune this round.

cards.title: Revenge Shield
cards.description: Anyone shocked last round is immune this round.

cards.title: Hot Seat
cards.description: The previous selected target is selected again. Target spinner is skipped.

cards.title: Echo
cards.description: The last shocked player is selected again. Target spinner is skipped.

cards.title: Villain Arc
cards.description: The player who has been shocked the least becomes the target.

cards.title: Karma
cards.description: The player who has been selected the least becomes the target.

cards.title: Repeat Offender
cards.description: The previous target is three times more likely to be selected.

cards.title: Unfinished Business
cards.description: The last shocked player is three times more likely to be selected.

cards.title: New Blood
cards.description: The least selected player is three times more likely to be selected.

cards.title: Double Trouble
cards.description: A second random player joins the selected target.

cards.title: Triple Threat
cards.description: Two extra random players join the selected target.

cards.title: Public Enemy
cards.description: Everyone is selected. Target spinner is skipped.

cards.title: No Hiding
cards.description: SAFE is removed from the target wheel this round.

cards.title: No Mass Panic
cards.description: The ALL segment is removed from the target wheel this round.

cards.title: All Or Nothing
cards.description: The ALL segment is ten times more likely this round.

cards.title: Who is Toaster?
cards.description: A suspicious appliance has entered the player list.

effects.name: Toaster
effects.resultText: Toaster had a malfunction. Better unplug it before it's found in the bathtub

cards.title: Vibe Check
cards.description: No shock this round. Fate is forced to vibration.

cards.title: No Mercy
cards.description: SAFE-style outcomes are removed where applicable.

cards.title: Safe Haven
cards.description: The SAFE target segment is doubled this round.

cards.title: Mercy Round
cards.description: Fate is capped at Medium or lower this round.

cards.title: Soft Landing
cards.description: Fate is capped at Low or lower this round.

cards.title: Loaded Chamber
cards.description: Brutal and Deathwish are twice as likely this round.

cards.title: Angry Wheel
cards.description: High, Brutal and Deathwish are twice as likely this round.

cards.title: Safe Is Boring
cards.description: Vibe and Warmup are half as likely this round.

cards.title: Chaos Wheel
cards.description: Every enabled fate category has equal weight this round.

cards.title: Fate Reversal
cards.description: The fate weights are inverted for this round.

cards.title: Sudden Death
cards.description: Only High, Brutal or Deathwish can be rolled this round.

cards.title: Warmup Only
cards.description: Fate is forced to Warmup.

cards.title: High Stakes
cards.description: Fate is forced to High.

cards.title: Double Tap
cards.description: If the result is a shock, the hidden double-hit is guaranteed.

cards.title: Coinflip Double
cards.description: If the result is a shock, the hidden double-hit chance becomes 50%. Faintly evil, statistically rude.

cards.title: Power Surge
cards.description: Shock values are increased by 15, capped by the server safety maximum.

cards.title: Half Power
cards.description: Shock values are halved this round.

cards.title: Share The Pain
cards.description: After the target is selected, they choose another player to join them.

cards.title: Bodyguard
cards.description: The spinner still shows the original target. After selection, choose a volunteer to take the hit instead. If nobody volunteers, the original target stays.

cards.title: Duel
cards.description: After the target is selected, they challenge another player. A random loser receives the fate.

cards.title: Choose Your Fate
cards.description: After the target is selected, they choose between Medium for sure or spinning the fate wheel.

cards.title: Coward's Bargain
cards.description: After the target is selected, they can take Vibe now or risk a guaranteed double-hit on the normal fate spin.

cards.title: Nemesis
cards.description: After the target is selected, they pick an opponent. Random loser receives the fate.

cards.title: Sacrifice
cards.description: The target chooses someone to join them, but the final shock value is halved.

cards.title: Executioner
cards.description: The last shocked player chooses the target, and double-hit chance becomes 50%.

cards.title: Coup d'État
cards.description: The host manually chooses the target and the fate is forced to Medium.

cards.title: Domino Effect
cards.description: One extra random player joins, but shock values are halved.

cards.title: Crowd Control
cards.description: Everyone is selected, but fate is capped at Low.

cards.title: Russian Roulette
cards.description: SAFE is removed and every target has equal chance as usual. One unlucky player faces the wheel.

cards.title: Tiny Chaos
cards.description: Everyone is selected and fate is forced to Vibe.

cards.title: Loaded Mercy
cards.description: SAFE is removed, but fate is capped at Medium.

cards.title: Trial By Fire
cards.description: The least shocked player becomes target, and High/Brutal/Deathwish are doubled.

cards.title: Forgotten Soul
cards.description: The player who has gone the longest without being selected becomes the target.

cards.title: Untouched Nerve
cards.description: The player who has gone the longest without a shock becomes the target.

cards.title: Vibe Virgin
cards.description: The player with the fewest vibe rounds becomes the target, and fate is forced to Vibe.

cards.title: Buzz Addict
cards.description: The player with the most vibe rounds gets picked again.

cards.title: Pain Debt
cards.description: The player with the lowest total shock intensity receives this round.

cards.title: Overcharged
cards.description: The player with the highest total shock intensity is pulled back into the game.

cards.title: Statistics Hate You
cards.description: The least shocked player is more likely to be selected, and brutal results are more likely.

cards.title: Fan Favorite
cards.description: The most selected player has a much higher target weight this round.

cards.title: Veteran Privilege
cards.description: The most shocked player is less likely to be selected, while SAFE is doubled.

cards.title: Long Memory
cards.description: The player who has gone longest without being selected has a huge target weight.

cards.title: Cold Streak
cards.description: The player who has gone longest without a shock has a huge target weight.

cards.title: Host Chooses Fate
cards.description: The host chooses the target manually, then the target chooses between a safe low hit or the wheel.

cards.title: Mercy or Madness
cards.description: Target chooses: guaranteed Medium, or random High/Brutal

cards.title: Last One Laughing
cards.description: The last shocked player picks the target, but SAFE is disabled.

cards.title: Everybody Hates Safe
cards.description: SAFE is removed from the target wheel and the fate wheel.

cards.title: Reverse Charity
cards.description: The lowest total intensity player gets selected, but fate is capped at Medium.

cards.title: Equalizer
cards.description: The least selected player is picked and all fate odds become equal.

cards.title: Villain Tax
cards.description: The most shocked player is selected, but the result is softened by 50%.

cards.title: The Wheel Remembers
cards.description: The previous target is excluded, and the longest not selected player is favored heavily.

cards.title: HR Complaint
cards.description: The player with the lowest multiplier has contacted HR. HR has reviewed the complaint and determined that the Host should wear their collar for the next round. Press Continue once the transfer is complete.

cards.title: Mutual Destruction
cards.description: The target chooses another player to share their fate. Both players receive the same result, including double-hits.

cards.title: No Good Options
cards.description: Target chooses between High, Low with guaranteed double-hit, or sharing the pain.
